title: H11 — Multiple Regression R²
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Perform multiple linear regression to predict house price using area and bathrooms as predictors. Only use rows without missing values in these three columns. Use a significance level of 0.05 for the predictors. Calculate the R-squared value of the model. Report your answer in this exact format: @significant_predictor[predictor_1,predictor_2] @r_squared[value] where predictor_1 corresponds to area, predictor_2 to bathrooms, each is yes or no based on p-value < 0.05, and r_squared is rounded to four decimal places
